get.description: Retrieve all forecast types configured for your portal. Forecast types define which properties are used to calculate forecasts, helping you understand and manage your sales projections effectively.

Retrieve a specific forecast type by its ID. This endpoint allows you to access detailed information about a particular forecast type configured in your HubSpot portal. It is useful for understanding how forecasts are calculated based on specific properties.

parameters.name: forecastTypeId
parameters.description: The ID of the forecast type to retrieve.
